description: Search products from brands that sell on Shopify. Each result says who sells it and whether that seller is the brand's official store, with a Coreplex link for full details. Prices and stock come from the live Shopify catalog at the time of the call. Checkout happens on the seller's own Shopify store; Coreplex adds no fees.

official_only.description: Only return listings sold by the brand's own official store.

query.description: What the shopper wants, in their words, e.g. "wearable breast pump" or "Owala FreeSip 24oz".
